_about: Entries confirmed on the running Linux HOI4 1.20.0.0 (GNU build ID 71806afa) that the static move from 1.19.4.1 left out. Each key was carried unchanged from the 1.19.4.1 table into a development table; the tool named in its evidence refused with layout_unmapped without the key and returned the stated GER 1936 values with it (24 November 2026, owned game on Xvfb, Regular, historical AI).
